Cell.Data: 请静下心来听会儿，我要给你讲一个故事。 一个关于龙与地下城，关于兽人与哥布林，关于 盗墓者与幽灵，关于国王与王后，但最重要的是 …关于巫师与荡妇，呃，关于巫师的故事。
these are spoken lines. Please imagine the actor speaking, the sound of the line. Don't stop at translation, but read it out loud. Does it sound like a funny vampire narrator?

Stay a while and listen, and I will tell you a story. A story of Dungeons and Dragons, of Orcs and Goblins, of Ghouls and Ghosts, of Kings and Quests, but most importantly -- of Wizards and Vamp -- Well... A story of Wizards.
曾几何时，在中原大陆上……
Once upon a time, in a land known as Midgård...
居住着一位有着强大魔法的巫师，名为格瑞姆尼， 他试图学会所有的魔法。尽管有很多古老的字符， 已经被遗忘在历史的角落。可一旦谁拥有了这样的魔法 知识，也许他就能代替当权者，引领巫师们把永恒 的和谐铺遍世界每一个角落……

There lived a powerful Wizard named Grimnír, who sought to harness the power of all Magicks -- ancient spells, crafted in times long forgotten. With such knowledge he might enable the wizards of the Order of Magick to spread eternal peace across all the lands...
可是当权者发现了格瑞姆尼的野心，他们感到恐惧， 所以暗中商议，制定了一个阴险的计划……
But the Order of Magick instead felt threatened by his ambitions, and in the shadows they schemed, and devised a treacherous plan…
…在这之后，格瑞姆尼的弟子受到驱逐， 而他自己，则终其一生，都被囚禁在世界的尽头 —边缘之境 一切都是源于他对黑暗魔法的沉迷。
…and so, Grimír's disciples were expelled from the Order, and he himself was, for all time, imprisoned at World's End. All because of his dangerous lust for knowledge.
格瑞姆尼的野心消散了， 当权者们自以为世界恢复了和平… 但是越来越多无辜的居民受到怪物的攻击。
Grimnír's dangerous ambitions dashed, the world was safe once more… Aside from the increased number of monsters attacking the good villagers.
之后，很快，整个兽人部落被兽人军阀可汗统一， 他四处烧杀掳掠，扩张领土… 现在已经威胁到了人类的圣地哈文德城。
And, of course, the warlord Khan, who had united the orc tribes, and now threatened the great city of Hávindr.
因此，在烟雾弥漫神秘晦暗的巫师城堡， 一位杰出的魔导师和他最优秀的学生正筹划着一场远征， 为了阻止世界陷入危机而奋斗，直到…永远……

But in the dusty gloom of Castle Aldrheim, where the Order of Magick dwelled, a brilliant teacher and his finest pupils were about to embark on a journey that would prevent the world from changing... ... Forever…
于是，我们年轻勇敢的小巫师决定启程去拯救世界， 而指引他们跨越各种艰难险阻的，正是英俊帅气风流倜傥玉树临风名冠天下的魔导师弗拉德， 他可不是个吸血鬼！ 当一行人到达神秘森林时，酝酿中的邪恶计划即将显山露水。
after mission 1 (that is, the wizard castle), this cutscene plays

And so our young and bold wizards set forth on their quest. Guiding them through the perils of the world was the dashingly handsome Vlad, who is by no means a vampire! As they approached Fornskogur Forest, it became clear that there was evil afoot.
挽救了维德堡，杀死了巨蟒，弗拉德带领小巫师来到了长风海岸。 在那里，牛头人暴走的谣言已经把大家吓得哭爹喊娘，有些甚至直接搬了家。 不过，小巫师一点儿也不担心，因为魔导师弗拉德拥有吸血鬼般强悍的能力， 胜利是必须的，妥妥的。
after mission 2, which ends with slaying the big serpent.

After saving the village of Veiditorp, and slaying the serpent Jormungandr, their journey took the wizards to the windy lands of the Hálöndin Coast. There, rumors of beastman raiders had scared away most of the settlers, and made all the children cry for their mummies. But with Vlad's almost vampiric powers aiding them in their quest, the wizards felt safe, and reassured that they could not fail.
犇旦村为了感激拯救他们的小巫师，特意提供了一辆能帮助救世主们尽快前往哈文德城的马车。 伟大的国王正在巫师们旅途的终点静候。 当一行人来到城门前，入冬以来的第一片雪花…正缓缓落下。

Saving the village of Dunderhead earned the wizards a carriage ride to Hávindr, where the good king awaited them at the end of their journey. And just as they reached the city gates, the first snowflake fell.
哈文德城经历了战火的洗礼，虽残垣断壁无数，却毫不影响人类抗争的斗志， 要把家仇国恨反馈给丑恶的敌人！ 当太阳升起，数千人…哦不…数百…至少有五十名英勇的战士矗立在晨光中！ 养兵千日用兵一时，现在他们已经做好准备迎击兽人军阀。
after saving the king in Havindr

Hávindr was in flames, but the siege had been broken, and the human army prepared their counter-attack. As the sun rose, there stood thousands... or well... hundreds... or certainly at least fifty stalwart men! Recent team-building exercises had kept them on their toes, and now they were ready to stand against the fearsome warlord Khan.
随着兽人领主可汗的死亡，格瑞姆尼邪恶的计划揭开了面纱。 聪明帅气的魔导师弗拉德建议小巫师做一件危险却意义重大的事情。 与其等待剩下军队的到来，不如自己主动出击，说不定会发现阴谋背后的真相。

With the warlord Khan dead, and Grímnir's terrible scheme revealed, the wise and handsome Vlad recommended that the wizards do the only sensible thing. Rather than waiting for the rest of the army, they should set forth at once, that they might discover the truth behind the terrible warlock threat.
弗拉德的时间魔法，将无助的小巫师从格瑞姆尼以及他背后的 神秘盟友阿萨多之魔掌中解救。现在，来自未来的弗拉德， 将指引小巫师回到巫师城堡，重新开始旅程，去寻找巨龙法夫纳 一位古老的魔法大师，也只有他能够告诉小巫师如何打败阿萨多。

Vlad's time travel Magick saved the helpless wizards from certain doom at the hands of Grimnír and his mysterious ally. Now, Vlad, who remained in the future, guided the wizards as they returned to Castle Aldrheim, where they once again began their journey, on a quest to find Fafnir -- a master of Magick, and the only one that could aid them in their quest to defeat Assatur.
小巫师又一次从他们的老家巫师城堡出发。依旧向北行进，只是中途改道去地下矿井， 相传那儿很久以前就被遗弃了，应该很安全…… 然而事实并非如此。

The wizards once again set forth from Castle Aldrheim. Again they headed northward, this time for the Járn Mines, which they were told was perfectly safe and long abandoned. As to be expected, this would prove not to be the case.
在摧毁了哥布林的地下城之后，小巫师离开了矿井，并树立了新的目标。 —找到吸血鬼伯爵，只有他能指引小巫师到巨龙法夫纳那儿去。 当玫瑰在黑暗的水面上沾染雾气，死亡的气息也沿着她们的刺尖阵阵散发出来。 没有了导师弗拉德，以往身边存在的那股安全感已飘然而去，这让小巫师感到非常孤独 ……内心深处弥漫着恐惧。

Emerging from the mines, after destroying the goblin civilization, the wizards set upon a new objective -- they should find the Count, who would bring them to Fafnir. As the mist rose from the murky water, the odor of death sent chills running down their spines! Without Vlad's reassuring presence, they were all alone -- and afraid.
一场糟糕的会面，使得小巫师与既是导师又是吸血鬼伯爵的弗拉德展开了战斗。 他别无选择，只得轻轻一弹指，击溃了小巫师，并将他曾经的学生放逐到死神领域。 在那里，小巫师得自个儿想办法重返现实世界，而且还不能忘了要继续寻找巨龙法夫纳。
in fact, they beat him, then he cheats at the end and casts them into the underworld. He's pretending that he won the battle against the players.

After a horrible misunderstanding, the wizards entered combat with the Count, who had little choice but easily defeat them, and cast them into the underworld of Niflheim. There they would seek someone who could return them to the corporeal realm -- and to Fafnir.
在继续找寻的任务中，小巫师与死神大战了一场，不知何故胜利来的如此容易。 死神，其实是个好人。他决定帮助勇敢的小巫师，将之传送到了寒风呼啸的雪山遗址。 据说古老的巨龙法夫纳就住在那片遗迹里。 雪山上冷的冒泡，小巫师颤栗不已。但不远处勉强肉眼可见的那座城堡，给了大家一线希望。

Countinuing their misscommunication, the wizards entered into a fight with death himself, somehow emerging victorious. Death -- who really is a nice guy, all things considered -- decided to help the wayward wizards, and teleported them to Galdrhöll Mountains, where the ancient Fafnir supposedly dwelled. The cold was blistering and terrible, but signs of a nearby castle offered a glimmer of hope.
说时迟那时快，小巫师与巨龙法夫纳展开了惨烈的战斗，最后差点儿就要杀死对方！ 幸好我…呃，未来的弗拉德及时出面阻止了大家。 法夫纳赐予小巫师一种很给力的魔法，能够将阿萨多从虚空领域拖入现实世界。 终于要进行最后的决战了！

Still incapable of forming sentences in stressful situations, the wizards did battle with Fafnir -- and nearly killed him! Luckily I… ehm… Future Vlad intervened just in time. Now equipped with the power to draw Assatur into the corporeal realm, the wizards were finally ready to do battle with the mighty daemon himself!
